ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: The hippocampus is a brain region related to memory. Female mice develop hippocampal atrophy in old age. To study the relationship between this phenomenon and the decrease in estrogen secretion, researchers used normal female mice and female mice whose ovaries were removed at sexual maturity (GDX female mice) to carry out related experiments, and part of the results is shown in the figure. According to the figure, what factors affect the number of synapses in the hippocampus and the hippocampal volume of female mice?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The hippocampus is a brain region related to memory. Female mice develop hippocampal atrophy in old age. To study the relationship between this phenomenon and the decrease in estrogen secretion, researchers used normal female mice and female mice whose ovaries were removed at sexual maturity (GDX female mice) to carry out related experiments, and part of the results is shown in the figure. According to the figure, what factors affect the number of synapses in the hippocampus and the hippocampal volume of female mice?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is divided into left and right bar charts. The vertical axis on the left indicates "relative number of synapses in the hippocampus", and the vertical axis on the right indicates "relative hippocampal volume". Each part is arranged according to the three age stages of young, middle-aged, and old; the legend shows that white bars are normal female mice and black bars are GDX female mice. Then reason: Comparing the bar heights of the same type of female mice at the different age stages of young, middle-aged, and old, it can be seen that the relative number of hippocampal synapses and the relative hippocampal volume change with age, indicating that age is an influencing factor. Comparing the bar heights of normal female mice and GDX female mice at the same age stage, there are differences between the two in some stages, and GDX female mice are female mice whose ovaries were removed at sexual maturity, indicating that whether ovaries are present also affects these indicators. Therefore, the factors affecting the number of synapses in the hippocampus and the hippocampal volume of female mice are age and ovaries.
